static.title: What a detector does to a measurement
static.note: A synthetic frame of one bright star and some fainter ones, made with the detector effects you switch on and measured with the Observatory’s photometry tool. The tool refuses a pixel at the linear limit and a pixel the frame’s sidecar flags; the number it would have given is shown beside the refusal.
